requirements.rule: The engine computes the rate of the separate taxation of arrears from PriorYearTaxFacts.net_income_biennio (art. 21 cc. 1, 3 TUIR) and reduces the tax by ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions, the deductions of artt. 12 and 13 cc. 1-2 the worker did not use in the years the arrears refer to (art. 21 c. 4). An arrears event that does not state them, among which the una tantum the engine pays itself, is taxed without the reduction, so the tax may be overstated.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.variable_pay.arrears.handlers._handle_arrears; art. 21 TUIR (Normattiva, text in force from 31-12-2024 to 31-12-2026, page sha256 9638f2c5aec6e3615193a672b6d07c3cd31083640b1c890b73022aa9951745f1)
requirements.remediation: State ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions from the worker's declaration of the deductions used each year; for the una tantum, carry it into the events the engine generates.

requirements.rule: ELEMENTO PEREQUATIVO (Sez. Quarta Tit. IV Art. 13, pp. 177-178): 485 euro a year with the June pay to the worker in service on 1 January of a company without second-level bargaining (EmployerProfile.second_level_premium false), for the months of the year before over twelve; the engine pays it (parameters.equalisation_element). Left open: the pay above the CCNL the worker received in the year before (superminimi, premi annui, other pay subject to contributions) has no field in the request; the engine reads it from the individual elements of the run, each amount on 31 December of the year before at the part-time fraction, for each month served, on twelve monthly payments, so an element agreed since, the share of the extra months or a yearly premium of the year before is not seen. A run without the employment period pays none; a second-level element the employer states counts when in force in the year before.
requirements.remediation: State the pay above the CCNL of the year before as a fact of the run, or pass the element as a bonus and leave the employer flag true.

requirements.rule: Art. 9 (Sez. IV Tit. III): the holidays of letters b and c in a sickness or a work injury reach 100% (sickness_rules.holiday and insured_absence.injury.holiday). Not calculated: the holiday top-up during pregnancy and puerperium, the patron saint substitute and 29 June, a letter b holiday in Rome only, outside the national calendar.
requirements.remediation: Top up pregnancy and puerperium holidays, the substitute patron holiday and Rome-only 29 June when the applicable local facts are stated.

requirements.rule: OVERTIME, QUOTE ESENTI (art. 7, ipotesi of 22 November 2025 p. 35): 8% more per overtime hour of the regime past 40 hours a year (shift workers, firms above 200 employees) or 48 (workers not on shifts in firms up to 200) is added when the event states the hours of the regime worked earlier in the year (OvertimeEvent.exempt_quota_hours_before) and, in a firm up to 200 employees, whether the worker is on shifts (OvertimeEvent.in_periodic_shift). Without those facts the premium is not added and the run carries this limitation.
requirements.remediation: State OvertimeEvent.exempt_quota_hours_before (and in_periodic_shift in a firm up to 200 employees) on the overtime of the quote esenti.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, PAR (Sez. Quarta, Titolo III, Art. 5, renewal of 22 November 2025 p. 33): the settore siderurgico (EmployerProfile.subsector steel) accrues 124 hours in place of 104, and the turnisti on 15 or more weekly shifts including the night shift (Employment.qualifying_shifts) 8 hours more. Not modelled: the 8 hours of the siderurgico turnisti, paid with the 13th; the further 4 hours from 2027 at 18 or more weekly shifts and 4 more from 2028 at 21 for the non siderurgico workers; and the hour of the sottosettori of the accordo of 16 July 1979 for the workers in service at 31 December 2012.
requirements.remediation: Add employment facts for 18 and 21 weekly shifts with night work and for the historical sottosettore, accrue their hours, and pay the siderurgico shift hours with the 13th.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2). A national CCNL rule that sets other hours to a day of leave or other rules of cumulation prevails (art. 32 c. 1-bis), and the bundle holds none; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event. Same-day cumulation with the other permits and rests of the decree, which the criterion excludes, is not checked.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: PART-TIME SUPPLEMENTARY HOURS: work up to 40 weekly hours earns an all-inclusive 10% on the overtime-premium pay elements until supplementary hours exceed 50% of agreed annual part-time hours; the excess earns 20% (CCNL 5 February 2021, PDF p. 58). The rate past the yearly share is paid when the event states the supplementary hours worked earlier in the year and the agreed annual hours (OvertimeEvent.supplementary_hours_before, agreed_annual_hours); without them the base rate is paid and the run carries this limitation. The elastic clauses of the same section (PDF p. 57: 10% for a rearranged placement of hours, 15% for an increase in duration up to 25% of the normal annual part-time hours) and the conditions of supplementary work are not modelled.
requirements.remediation: State OvertimeEvent.supplementary_hours_before and agreed_annual_hours on the supplementary hours; the elastic clauses (10% and 15%) remain outside the model.

requirements.rule: MULTI-WEEK SCHEDULE AND NIGHT SHIFT WORK: the premiums of the orario plurisettimanale of Art. 5 as renewed on 22 November 2025 (15% Monday to Friday and 25% on Saturday, 20% and 30% for sudden needs, raised by 8% from the 81st hour, p. 32 of the signed scan) and the onnicomprensive night shift rates of Art. 7 (20%, 60%, 35% from 1 June 2013; 25%, 65%, 40% from 22 to 6) are not modelled. The shift column of the overtime of Art. 7 is: OT_NOTTURNO_TURNI, OT_NOTTURNO_TURNI_EXTRA and OT_NOTTURNO_FESTIVO_TURNI for an event with in_periodic_shift.
requirements.remediation: Model the multi-week premiums of Art. 5 and the night shift supplements of Art. 7 with a fact naming the schedule of the worker, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: The una tantum of a renewal is paid from the CCNL data with readings no text read settles in full: a month of service in the covered period counts with the days of the una tantum (15 when the text is silent), over the months of the period; the absences of a month do not reduce it, though a text may pay the months 'di effettiva prestazione'; a part time is paid in proportion to its hours; a run without the employment period is paid none; the share of the covered months of earlier years is taxed apart as arrears.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.una_tantum.rules.una_tantum_events; CCNL agenti immobiliari FIAIP 19 May 2025 art. 163 (pp. 97-98, sha256 560d16410d3e41dc0bfb00bfe2a40ef65f2cd900234aeaee92018ed9fa21ead5)
requirements.remediation: Source the counting of the months, the part time and the taxation of each una tantum from its agreement, then resolve this limitation.
